name: Qwen3-8B-DMS-8x
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A derivative of Qwen/Qwen3-8B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.191 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-01-19. CAVEATS: Not a fine-tune: DMS applies inference-time per-head KV-cache sparsification at 8x, with learned eviction policies trained while the backbone stays Qwen3-8B (same 8.191B tensor set). Gains are modest and mixed: MATH-500 95.5/95.1, HumanEval 89.6/87.8, ArenaHard 89.7/88.4, RULER 64K 76.2/69.2, but GPQA 57.6/58.8, MMLU-Pro 73.5/74.2, AIME24 73.0/75.0, IFEval 88.8/90.3 and RULER 128K 21.4/25.0 all regress. Licence tag is 'other' (NVIDIA community licence).
